'''Ugloste''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ugnaught]] who operated the [[carbon-freezing chamber]] in [[Cloud City]] and froze [[Han Solo]] in [[3 ABY]]. He was in charge on determining how to use carbon-freezing on [[human]]s, like Solo.<ref name="Force Collection" /> Ugloste witnessed Solo being frozen and surviving the process.<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Having worked away for humans before he even came to Cloud City, Ugloste had little compunction when the time came to freeze the [[smuggler]] Han Solo in carbonite.<ref name="Force Collection" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ugloste was played by [[Jack Purvis]] in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Episode V" /> After restoration work, Ugloste's mask sold for $34,000 at auction in [[2020]].<ref name="Prop">{{WebCite|url=https://usm.propstoreauction.com/m/lot-details/index/catalog/267/lot/62814|text=Lot #706 - Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1980) - Chief Ugnaught's Mask|archivedate=20201101073731}}</ref>
